Subject: Vendor onboarding — invoice submission (portal vs email) and sample rows

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the onboarding kick-off yesterday. A couple of finance/invoice questions came up while we map Raindrop's ERP to your intake:

- We currently submit invoices as PDF+PO stamped on the PDF. Our AR team can also export compact CSV rows (attached) for mass billing. Which is Redwood preferred? Portal ingestion or email fallback?
- Does your portal require the PO number embedded in invoice text, or will a PO referenced in file metadata (e.g., the CSV has a PO column) be sufficient for automatic PO-matching?
- We have some EU entities where VAT IDs must be present on the invoice PDF. Can we still use the portal (preferred) or do we need a region-specific workflow?

Attached is a short sample CSV showing multi-PO rows and line-level quantities.

Attachment: sample_invoice_rows.csv (CSV, 3 KB)

If you prefer, we can stand up an SFTP folder or push via EDI — want to understand Redwood's support matrix before we propose changes to our AR process.

Appreciate any guidance and the minimal template you prefer.

Best,

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear questions and the sample CSV. Forwarding to Steph (procurement ops) and Marcus (AP) so we have full alignment.

Short answer upfront: portal-first, email fallback. A few details and the minimal template we need below so you can pick the least-disruptive path for your ERP.

Portal-first (recommended)
- Use the vendor onboarding portal: https://vendor.redwood.com/onboard (we'll activate your company record once we get the onboarding form).
- Required fields at submission: Supplier ID (we'll assign), Redwood PO number, Invoice date, Invoice total, Currency, Line-level description + quantity (CSV/CSV-in-zip supported).
- For EU invoices: VAT ID is required on the invoice PDF or in the CSV column 'vat_id'. The portal validates VAT presence for entities tagged as EU.

Email fallback (allowed during pilot / legacy vendors)
- Subject pattern: INV: <invoice-number> | PO: <po-number> (this helps our ingestion worker).
- Attachments we accept: PDF (single invoice per PDF preferred) or compact CSV with a header row. If your PDF does not contain the PO number visually, include a small .meta file (or put PO in email body) — otherwise PO-match may fail.

PO-matching rules
- If PO is present in CSV PO column or visible in PDF text we auto-match. Metadata-only PO (e.g., stored outside of file payload) is unreliable unless you also include the PO in the email body or a small .txt file.

SFTP/EDI
- We support SFTP drop and S3 ingestion for high-volume partners; Marcus can share the onboarding spec and the ACK timing (we issue an ingest ack within 2 hrs in most cases).

Attached for your convenience: compact_template_v1.csv and our vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fill and upload to the portal).

Next steps (proposed)
1) Sarah: choose Portal or Email fallback for initial 30-day pilot and return the onboarding form.
2) Steph: validate Raindrop's VAT treatment for EU entity and confirm whether a separate Redwood supplier record is needed per legal entity.
3) Marcus: provide SFTP credentials/spec if Raindrop prefers a push method.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the portal fields.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks Kimberly — super helpful. A couple of clarifying items after reviewing the template: 

1) Our ERP can produce the CSV with PO in a column but when we emit PDF we cannot reliably render the PO on the PDF body (our current print template stamps PO in TIFF metadata only). If the portal can accept the CSV rows attached to the portal submission we can switch to CSV-first for automated matching.

2) For EU entities, VAT IDs are present in our legal-entity records and we can populate 'vat_id' in the CSV. If Redwood requires the VAT to be on a PDF for legal purposes (audit trail), we may need a manual exception for a few countries.

3) ACK timing: is the 'ingest ack within 2 hrs' a formal SLA for pilot? We need an expectation for our AR team.

Also attaching a short example of how our ERP emits metadata-only PO (so you can see why we asked).

Attachment: erp_metadata_sample.txt (TXT, 800 bytes)

If CSV ingestion is accepted by portal and VAT in csv is sufficient, we can flip the majority of our runs to CSV and use email PDF only for exceptions.

Best,
Sarah

> 
> 1) Our ERP can produce the CSV with PO in a column but when we emit PDF we cannot reliably render the PO on the PDF body (our current print template stamps PO in TIFF metadata only). If the portal can accept the CSV rows attached to the portal submission we can switch to CSV-first for automated matching.

Thanks for the example, Sarah — we can absolutely accept CSV uploads to the portal and run line-level matching off the PO column. That is the recommended path for high-volume partners.

EU VATs: Portal will accept the VAT in the CSV column and we will persist it on the invoice record. However, for certain EU reconciliation requirements (Germany & Italy we typically see), our tax team asks for the VAT to also appear on a human-readable invoice (PDF). We'll treat those as exceptions and have a short manual approval path — Steph, can you confirm which countries we should flag as "pdf-needed" for the vendor onboarding record?

ACK timing / SLA: For the pilot we can commit to a 2-hour ingest ack for portal and SFTP submissions during business hours (M-F 9-5 PT). For email fallback, ack is best-effort within 24 hours. Marcus will coordinate the automation for a faster ack if you choose SFTP.

Decision summary / Pilot plan
- Portal ingestion (CSV-first) — PRIMARY path. Raindrop to complete onboarding form and upload first 3 weeks of CSVs via portal sandbox.
- Email fallback — allowed for legacy invoices; use subject pattern above and include .txt metadata file if PO won't be in the PDF body.
- Region exceptions — Germany & Italy: require PDF with visible VAT on invoice; Redwood will mark these during supplier activation.

- Sarah: complete vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and indicate legal entities + which entity will be the payee (due: Fri, Mar 26).
- Stephanie: confirm list of EU countries that require visible VAT on PDF (due: Wed, Mar 24).
- Marcus: share SFTP spec and sandbox credentials if Raindrop wants to pilot SFTP (due: Tue, Mar 30).

Happy to do a quick call if you want to run the first CSV together.
